admission_process.title: Boston Institute of Management Admission Process 2025

paragraphs: Boston Institute of Management admissions areopen. The college offers admisison to courses at UG, PG and Diploma levels. Boston Institute of Management admission is completely merit-based. Students are offered admissions based on their merit of the last qualifying exam. Moreover, students interested in applying for admission to BSc, MBA or Diploma courses can apply directly on the college's official website atBoston Institute of Management. More details around Boston Institute of Management admission 2025 is elaborated in the article below.

Boston Institute of Management admissions for UG, PG and Diploma courses is based on merit obtained in the final exam of Class 10/12 & UG degree. There is no entrance exam required to get admission, however candidates must fulfill the basic eligibility requirements for their desired programme. More details related to Boston Institute of Management course admission 2025 for various courses is mentioned in the table below:
Know more aboutBoston Institute of Management courses
Check below the detailed steps for Boston Institute of Management admission process 2025:
Step 1: Application Process
Apply through an online/ offline form application process for BSc, MBA or Diploma programmes. Students must also pay an application fee of INR 100 to complete the submission
Step 2: Selection Rounds

Boston Institute of Management admissions are entirely merit-based. To get selected for Diploma and UG programmes, students must pass Class 10 & 12, respectively. However, to pursue a PG degree, passing graduation is must.
Step 3: Final Admission
At the completion of the selection process, the qualified students must make the fee payment to confirm their admission at the college.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Artificial Intelligence and Data Science - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Campus life is vibrant with cultural and technical fests.

content.Placements: Around 70% of students from AI & this get placed every year. The highest package offered is around 12 LPA, the average package offered is 4 to 6 LPA, and the lowest package offered is 3 LPA. Top recruiters include TCS, Wipro, Infosys, and Capgemini. Internships are offered in firms like TCS iON and AI/ML startups. Roles include Data Analyst, AI Engineer, Software Developer, and ML Engineer. Placement training and mock interviews help improve results.
content.Infrastructure: The campus has modern labs, Wi-Fi, smart classrooms, and a rich library. AI labs are equipped with the latest software and high end systems. The hostel has spacious rooms with Wi-Fi and 24/7 security. Food in the mess is decent with hygienic preparation. Medical facilities, sports, and a gym are available for students. Overall, infrastructure supports both academics and personal growth.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Information Technology - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: A decent start, but it needs improvement.

content.Placements: Placement opportunities are limited especially for core branches. Only a few companies visit the campus and the packages offered are mostly low. Students are good and almost all receive placement training but it's not very impactful in terms of real results.
content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure is good, but non-AC rooms and labs are also adequate. Classes are clean, and the service provided at facilities is okay. The college is clean, and overall, it's good. I'd give it 5 stars.
content.Faculty: Teachers are good and powerful, and they provide good learning experiences. Some professors are helpful and experienced, while others are less engaging or hard to approach. Teaching methods are mostly theory-based with a limited focus on overall practical knowledge.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Artificial Intelligence and Data Science - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: For me, the placements are decent, but faculty or infrastructure is good. The campus is also good.

content.Placements: Placements are decent in our college. Only 20-30% of students get good placements through college. So, I would rate it three stars only. Students got placed with good packages. review_summary.college_name: Satya Group of Institutions Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Mechanical Engineering - Batch of 2018
individual_reviews.title: It is a good college for students who have financial problems and want to complete their degree.

content.Placements: It was not a good college for the placement purpose because this college provides fake placements. However, in this college, there was a separate placement cell and placement faculty members, but they do not prepare students well for facing interviews.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of our college was very good, and there was a good college building. Classrooms were well-designed with furniture and projectors along with the camera facility and Wi-Fi. Hostel, canteen, mess and food facilities were good at this college.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2014
individual_reviews.title: The management on the campus should be good. Teachers are always ready to fight.

content.Placements: Our college did not provide any placements. Only BPO companies were coming for placement. Most of the students leave the company after joining because they want to work as programmers and not as support executives. I think if you want such a job, then don't opt for this college.
content.Infrastructure: During the time of admission, the authorities will tell you that you can use the Wi-Fi of this college, but you can't use it without permission of the IT department. They misbehave with students. Don't choose this college.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2020
individual_reviews.title: I am dissatisfied because of false placement promises of the college.

content.Placements: The college does not provide placements. This year not a single company visited our college for placements.
content.Infrastructure: Labs are equipped with computers, and that's the biggest accomplishment as those computers don't have the required software for students to learn. So either bring your own laptop or learn from external sources. Quality of the food served in the canteen is very low.
content.Faculty: Teachers in our college are relatively helpful and knowledgeable. But the course curriculum will not provide you with a job. To get a job, you need to learn from external sources. Their teaching quality is average as only a few teachers actually know what they are teaching.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2020
individual_reviews.title: I enjoyed a lot in the college because of good faculty, facilities, and placements provided in 2015.

content.Placements: Placements for my senior batch are quite good. Around 60% of the students got placed. The highest salary package offered was 2.4 LPA, the lowest package was 1.2 LPA, and the average package offered was 1.8 LPA. Companies that visited the campus are Microsoft, Mahindra, IBM, etc. Roles offered to the students are general manager, developer, assistant engineer, etc. Around 75% of the students got internships. There is a placement cell, and it is useful for us.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure and facilities provided in our college are very good. All the facilities like Wi-Fi, labs, classrooms, a library, medical facilities and sports facilities are available. Labs and classrooms are well-maintained. Quality of food in the canteen is somewhat better. Hostel rooms are good. I didn't face any infrastructure related issue during my tenure at the college.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2013
individual_reviews.title: I'm absolutely satisfied with the faculty and infrastructure.

content.Placements: Placements in our college were good enough. Many companies visited our college for placements. The placement rate of our batch and our senior batch was 80%. Companies like Wipro, HCL, E-Trade Services, Infosys, and Tech Mahindra, visited the campus to offer jobs with good salary packages. International placement opportunities are also provided in Satya Group of Institutions.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of our college is very good. The college provides opportunities to play all sports. Facilities like laboratories and canteen are available. The campus environment is very good, and the campus has a lot of greenery. Hostel and gym facilities are available within the campus. It provides medical facilities in emergency cases.

review_summary.college_name: Selvam Educational Institutions Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Electronics and Communication Engineering - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Selvam Educational Institutions are good.

content.Placements: The highest salary package offered in our course 5 LPA. Teachers are highly experienced and knowledgeable. There is good training for placements. Semester exams are not difficult. Our college has various departments with more opportunities for placements in various companies.
content.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi is allowed only for laptops. Classrooms are very good, and the hostel food is also good. But they have high rates. Hostel room and facilities are excellent. I am lucky to study at this college. We have very high-cost laboratory materials in the college.

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Civil Engineering - Batch of 2020
individual_reviews.title: Our college has good placements. Teachers are knowledgeable, and the infrastructure is very good.

content.Placements: Civil engineering is the best branch for placements. About 80% of the students got internships. Some good companies visit our college and hire students. About 30% of the students got placements, and some students got placed in local companies. The highest salary package offered is 10 LPA, while the lowest salary package offered is 4 LPA.
content.Infrastructure: All facilities are good, and there are a Wi-Fi facility and library. Google classrooms are good, and sports and canteen are good in our college. Medical facilities are good and always available, and the sports coach is good, who provides daily motivation and guidelines.

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Electrical and Electronics Engineering - Batch of 2016
individual_reviews.title: The college for learn to easy and get to freedom.

content.Placements: Only the low scale companies come to the college. Last year, the placement rate was 87%. The placement training classes are available, it is the most amazing training class. An excellent placement programme is provided. Last year, the medium salary package was offered to the students. The college provides good services.
content.Infrastructure: The college structure, hostel, food, and sports are good. The college is promoting sports to the national and international standards. In sports quota, the college provides a free seat, free accommodation and free food. The google classrooms are amazing. The hostel rooms are big and have good water service.

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Electronics and Communication Engineering - Batch of 2016
individual_reviews.title: The truth about my college, and I love it.

content.Placements: During our final year, we had some placements in various fields, i.e. both professional and BPO. In my set, we had a placement of 87% but less than 5% of the people went to the job got via placement. The minimum salary is Rs. 1,00,000/annum and the maximum salary is Rs. 4,50,000/annum (off-campus). Allsec, Zealous, Span Technologies, Aqua Retails, Tech Mahindra are the companies that visit. Marketing, call centre, developers in start-ups are the roles offered. There is no internship. We have a placement cell. They are trying to do their best for our betterment.

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Electronics and Communication Engineering - Batch of 2016
individual_reviews.title: Good place to educate yourself.

content.Placements: To be frank the placing student capacity of my batch was a bit more when compared to our seniors. Placement percentage had been increased from 73.3% to 86.3%. The highest salary offered was 4.5 L by IVTL Infoview and lowest salary was 1.44 L. For ECE, core companies like Zebronics, TATA Communications and many came with affordable packages, student were offered roles of junior engineers, trainee engineers etc. Many startup IT companies like JusPay, Vernalis etc recruited CSE & IT department students with good packages. MNCs like Tech Mahindra, HCL also had conducted their drives.

individual_reviews.title: This is a great place for learning.

content.Placements: Maximum percentage of students got placements with a good package. The highest salary is 22 LPA, and this college offers various on-campus offers in Concentric and all. There are many various projects and internships that help us in our final year for job opportunities.
content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure and all are very good, and the atmosphere of the college is great and it's peaceful. The labs are very well reserved with well equipment. Faculty members also help us with the labs, and we can do experiments by ourslef with the help of the teachers.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: This is my review of my college.

content.Placements: Placements at Chaithanya are very basic. Most of the companies are showing very interest in Chaitanya to recruit students. Several students have been placed in top Indian companies like Infosys, Tata Steel, and Accenture, with the highest package reaching 7 LPA.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure at Chaithanya is quite basic but of good quality, including classrooms equipped with digital labs and a neat, clean playground. The washrooms are hygienic, and the canteen offers basic-quality food. The labs are of excellent quality, and hostel rooms are clean and hygienic.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Really good faculty and good facilities with the lowest fees, but with average faculty.

content.Placements: I don't know the percentage, but I guess nearly twenty students have been placed through campus drive across different companies. There are many companies that are coming to the college; the only thing is that the students here take studies for granted and don't read.
content.Infrastructure: We will get basic facilities and infrastructure, and there is no Wi-Fi. As for the food in the mess, it is okay, but my friends sometimes don't eat there because of the quality. The canteen is better than the mess, and many of the hostellers usually tend to eat here if the food in the mess is not good.

individual_reviews.course: Diploma in Computer Engineering - Batch of 2023
individual_reviews.title: Dissatisfied Because of Placements and Internship and Really Good faculty members and Facilities.

content.Placements: There are no placements or companies visiting the college. The college does not provide any internships, so we have to find them on our own. There are no roles offered by the college, and it does not support placement in any way. The overall placement situation is very disappointing.
content.Infrastructure: The college doesn't provide the Wi-Fi password to students. Lab rooms are big and spacious. Computers are working properly. Classrooms are also spacious and good. review_summary.college_name: DITM - Delhi Institute Of Technology And Management Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: It has a chill campus life and a good area.

content.Placements: The package offered is 64 LPA, and the average salary offered is 6 LPA. Placement opportunities are excellent in my course. Almost 90% of students got placed in top companies like TCS, Infosys, and Amazon. The package offered ranges from 4-20 LPA. Many students also got internships in reputed firms with great roles.
content.Infrastructure: Classrooms are so good and fully furnished with AC, food, and everything is top-notch. Our department has modern labs, high-speed Wi-Fi, smart classrooms, and a well-stocked library. The hostel is comfortable with decent rooms. There is a good variety of food in the mess and canteen. The medical care and sports facilities keep students' lives balanced.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: A below average college, but great if you just want a degree.

content.Placements: The placement is really bad last year, only 23 students were placed in a batch of 90-100 in my subject. I don't know about the highest package but there was a person with 7 LPA. You can get internships in our college if you have the basic skills. There is an internship cell that is mostly run by students and you can apply and if you clear the interview, it's up to you.
content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure is below average. There are no ACs, no great bathrooms, no Wi-Fi, and the library is not that great, but you can sit and read books if you want to study for your course. I don't live in hostel but the canteen is also below average, more like a confectionary shop than a canteen. But there is a temple, which is nice.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Review of DITM - Delhi Institute of Technology and Management.

content.Placements: Students who have good skills will easily get placed in our college. Placements depend on students' skills. Many top companies visit our college to recruit students. The top recruiting company is TCS. The highest salary package offered is 25 LPA. The average salary package offered ranges between 5 LPA - 6 LPA.
content.Infrastructure: Our college provides us with all facilities. Our classrooms are spacious. Our college has 2 computer labs. The canteen is not much good. It doesn't have much variety of food items. Wi-Fi is very good. Our college has a good playground. The library has many books.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: Honest review of Delhi Institute of Technology and Management.

content.Placements: This is a T3 college so no big tech giants visit for placements. But you will get what you will expect from a T3 college. Most of the students get placed in mass recruiting companies with a minimum salary package of 3 LPA and a maximum salary package of 12 LPA. No companies will offer internships. The students have to look for off-campus internships. Mostly, front-end engineers and software development engineers are hired. You have to prepare on your own for placements because faculty members are not that good.
content.Infrastructure: Hostels are the best part of this college. The quality of rooms is better than IITs and other top colleges. There are 3 seater rooms but mostly 2 people stay in a room. Wi-Fi is provided by the college. The speed is also good around 200 Mbps. Water is available every time. Rooms are cleaned on daily basis. The quality of mess food is good and it is the best part and very diverse. Every day they are trying to make something new.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2019
individual_reviews.title: Infrastructure and also facilities are good. College is under IP, so now it's good for admission.

content.Placements: In placements, academically top students get placed, and average students don't get placed by the university. About 50% of students got placed through our university. TCS, Tech Mahindra and many more reputed companies visit here for placement drives. About 60% of students get internships. Tester or developer roles are offered here.
content.Infrastructure: Everything is good here, but the canteen is not good and not organised. Medical facilities are not available. The sports ground is big, but sports are not available. The hostel is good, but the food served is the worst. The number of students available is low in our college, and Bihar and Nepal students are more than Delhi students.

reviews.review_heading: It has a chill campus life and a good area.
reviews.review_text: Classrooms are so good and fully furnished with AC, food, and everything is top-notch. reviews.review_heading: A below average college, but great if you just want a degree.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is below average. There are no ACs, no great bathrooms, no Wi-Fi, and the library is not that great, but you can sit and read books if you want to study for your course. I don't live in hostel but the canteen is also below average, more like a confectionary shop than a canteen. But there is a temple, which is nice.

reviews.review_heading: Review of DITM - Delhi Institute of Technology and Management.
reviews.review_text: Our college provides us with all facilities. Our classrooms are spacious. Our college has 2 computer labs. The canteen is not much good. It doesn't have much variety of food items. Wi-Fi is very good. Our college has a good playground. The library has many books.

reviews.review_heading: Honest review of Delhi Institute of Technology and Management.
reviews.review_text: Hostels are the best part of this college. The quality of rooms is better than IITs and other top colleges. There are 3 seater rooms but mostly 2 people stay in a room. Wi-Fi is provided by the college. The speed is also good around 200 Mbps. Water is available every time. Rooms are cleaned on daily basis. The quality of mess food is good and it is the best part and very diverse. Every day they are trying to make something new.

reviews.review_heading: Infrastructure and also facilities are good. College is under IP, so now it's good for admission.
reviews.review_text: Everything is good here, but the canteen is not good and not organised. Medical facilities are not available. The sports ground is big, but sports are not available. The hostel is good, but the food served is the worst. The number of students available is low in our college, and Bihar and Nepal students are more than Delhi students.

reviews.review_heading: I am satisfied with the college, and would recommend you to join this.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the college is very good and calm. Classrooms are also clean and hygienic. The library is very huge with a lot of books available. I am good at sports, and the institute provides me with the opportunities to perform at the intercollege level also.

reviews.review_heading: Till 2013, the campus placements were good, but now, they invite very few BPO companies.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi facility is not available. Classrooms are air-conditioned. The campus crowd is poor. The canteen is also poor. Sports and games facilities are good. All the books are available in the library. Hostel rooms are good, but the food provided isn't good. The infrastructure of our college is good, but the crowd and faculty need to be improved.

reviews.review_heading: College life at DITM (College).
reviews.review_text: Best part about college now is Wi-Fi, I missed those days when the Wi-Fi was there but it has changed a lot in past few years. Since it's been a long time ago, I used to be the part of DITM in 2014 but I must say, nothing has changed in infrastructure.

reviews.review_heading: It is a well-organised college.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of our college is average but good at certain things. It includes clean washrooms and well-maintained science labs. Food served in the canteen is hygienic. The college does provide a hostel facility at nominal rates. Hostels are well-furnished with almost all the facilities.

reviews.review_heading: The college lacks in infrastructure, sanitation and drinking water facilities.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the college is average. The college provides the facilities like Wi-Fi, but it is not accessible to every classroom in the campus. The labs of the college, especially Computer Science labs are large and more in number, but many computers in the labs are not in working condition. There is a medical dispensary in the college, but it is closed most of the time. The classrooms on the campus are not cleaned every day. There is a lot of dust on the benches, and we can't sit on th...

reviews.review_heading: I am pretty much satisfied with the college.
reviews.review_text: Facilities provided by the college were very good. There are proper Wi-Fi connections on each floor. The library was well-maintained and stocked. Medical facilities were very ethical. Computer labs had a good amount of PCs and configuration was also good. Overall, it is a good college regarding facilities.

reviews.review_heading: The college is not that good, and the placements are zero.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the college is not that good. There is no playground for sports, and the labs were hideous. The Wi-Fi connection was very slow, and the systems were very old. The ACs are too old, and they are not working. The canteen food was not good and was costly too. The library was fine but not so good, and it remains closed every time.

reviews.review_heading: Good infrastructure and facilities.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is very good, the environment is peaceful. There are plenty number of classrooms, there are 2 libraries and yes no of playgrounds for playing games. Our college organizes various number of inter level sports competition and quiz shows.

reviews.review_heading: Good staff and infrastructure, but I am dissatisfied with the placements.
reviews.review_text: The college infrastructure is very good. It is Wi-Fi enabled campus. The library is also good. The labs and classrooms are excellent. The quality of food was decreased day by day. First, there was a big canteen, but now, the area was reduced because that space was used to build the girls hostel.

reviews.review_heading: Good infrastructure and show off.
reviews.review_text: They have good infrastructure to show to the students. Their infrastructure is too good as compared to other colleges. The hostel facility is not too good as other colleges. There is a canteen, but the canteen facility is not good, so I advice not to go to that college.

overview_faqs.question: What is the average starting salary after completing BTech Food Technology course?
overview_faqs.answer: After you have completed your BTech Food Technology course at a decent college in India, you can get some amazing earning opportunities in the business world. The average starting salary for fresh graduates like you is usually around INR 4 LPA. As you move forward in the work sector and gain some years of experience, you will start to earn more as recruiters will be ready to offer you a higher salary package because of your technical expertise. For mid-senior level positions, the salary package is mostly between INR 5 LPA and INR 8 LPA. For senior level positions, the salary package is above INR 8 LPA.

individual_reviews.title: The college is good with good placements.

content.Placements: This college is good for studying. 70% of students are placed on average paced 3-4 Lacs per year. Most students are placed in the B.Tech branch in the CS branch many companies come into this college like Tata and Wipro. The company offers the role of software development problem-solving field.
content.Infrastructure: This college offers various features such as Wi-Fi and both air-conditioned and non-air-conditioned rooms. The library is decent, but the books are quite old. Additionally, there are multiple festivals and functions held throughout the year, including a fresher's party for new students.

individual_reviews.title: From my side, this college is the best for becoming OT technician, etc.

content.Placements: This college provides the best placements for students; they also provide internships for students. individual_reviews.course: Diploma in Mechanical Engineering - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Good college for engineering and good placements.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: Vijaya: The Women’s College Life

content.Placements: College placements are good and need improvement to focus more on placement drives. Fewer placements are available in our college. In that, most of the interviews are available in non-core sides only. In the core side, fewer placements are provided so that most of the students are not placed in interviews.
content.Infrastructure: In our college, we have a simple library, and fewer computer systems are available. The food in our hostel is not tasty and not healthy, and it will be available in less time, like 1 hour. And the canteen is also not maintaining hygiene. Labs are also not maintaining properly.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: Good placements and nice faculty.

content.Placements: Above a 7 CGPA, students offered in our college receive a highest package of 5 LPA, and the average is 3.5 LPA. We can do many internships; roles offered are internships as well as many roles regarding subjects like Python, C, and Java. There are many internships available, such as those in Python or AI.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is good, with a library that has many useful books for reference, high-speed Wi-Fi, a big canteen, and good hostel accommodation. Every week, there are three hours of sports, including throwball, shuttle, kho-kho, and kabaddi, along with one hour of games like tennikoit and other drill hours to maintain fitness.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: It is a very good college.

content.Placements: The highest salary package offered was 4.2 LPA. Top recruiting companies are Capgemini, Infosys, and Wipro. We have advanced subjects, and they are very helpful for a better future.
content.Infrastructure: Laboratories are not well-equipped. Classrooms are well-maintained. There is a decent library in this college. Canteen is available. Sports are conducted in this college. Laboratories are also not air-conditioned.
content.Faculty: The pass percentage is average. The teaching quality is good. Semester exams are difficult. If we work hard, we can easily score good marks. As it has self-center, exams are held strictly. CCTV surveillance is also available during exams.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Information Technology - Batch of 2023
individual_reviews.title: Good college to prefer.

content.Placements: Above 80 percent of students were placed in our course. The highest package offered in our course is 39L package and the lowest are 3-4L package. Top Recruiting companies in our college are infosys, tcs, cognizant, big works, hcl, wipro. Top roles offered in our course are software developer, team manager.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of our college is good it has all facilities to pursue your degree. The canteen food was really good and hostel mess food too.
content.Faculty: The teachers were very helpful and knowledgeable. The semester exams are bit hard and the pass percentage was quite good.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2019
individual_reviews.title: There are good infrastructure and facilities.

content.Placements: About 60% of the students got placed from our course. The highest salary package offered in our course was 3 LPA, while the lowest salary package offered was Rs. 60,000 per annum. The average salary package offered was 1 LPA. Wipro, TCS and Capgemini are the top recruiting companies for our course. Only 1% of the students got internships from our course. Software developer role is offered in our course.
content.Infrastructure: Lab facilities are very good here, and the maintenance of classrooms is perfect and clean. The quality of the food available in our mess and canteen is very good. We used to play many sports in our college, and there are many facilities for games. Medical facilities are also provided.

Hence, aspirants with 60% in their bachelor's degree are eligible for admission provided they also fulfil the selection requirements. Candidates must have a valid TANCET score for MBA admission.

faqs.question: Is entrance exam required for admission at SNS B-SPINE?
faqs.answer: Yes, candidates need to have a valid TANCET score for admission at SNS B-SPINE. Tamil Nadu Common Entrance Test is conducted once in a year at the state level in offline mode. Aspirants need to appear for TANCET and score equal or above the cutoff to get admission in the MBA programme.

faqs.question: Can I get direct admission at SNS B-SPINE?
faqs.answer: SNS B-SPINE offers admission based on entrance-exam score. Candidates wishing to get admission in MBA programme need to first apply for the course. Applicants are shortlisted based on their eligibility and TANCET score in MBA programme. Once selected candidates need to come for document verification and fee payment.
